purpose: Read-only Storybook evidence inventory for representative mature Lite user surfaces.

scopeExclusions.reason: Agency IA remains a prototype and is not authorized for production cutover.
Historical migration belongs to the active Agency delivery lane.
Trading evidence is owned by the Trading lane.
The current story is a sell-side workspace and remains in the Trading evidence lane.

surfaces.label: Capability Center
surfaces.userJob: Understand available governed capabilities and inspect their current evidence without changing formal state.

UNAVAILABLE.reason: No story isolates owner-data unavailability from recoverable request failure.

surfaces.label: Content Studio
surfaces.userJob: Review governed content work, distinguish preparation from approval, and understand incomplete owner context.

LOADING.reason: The story set covers mutation-busy but not initial workspace loading.

STALE_OR_NEEDS_REFRESH.reason: No fixture-backed story demonstrates a stale content snapshot that needs refresh.

surfaces.label: Execution Release
surfaces.userJob: Review whether prepared work is ready for a governed release without treating payment or preparation as completion.

UNAVAILABLE.reason: Recoverable request failure exists, but an explicit unavailable-data state does not.

PERMISSION_RESTRICTED.reason: No Storybook fixture demonstrates a release queue the user cannot access.

surfaces.label: Contextual AI Guide
surfaces.userJob: Ask for contextual guidance while seeing when the selected asset is missing or no longer current.

LOADING.reason: No story demonstrates asset or guidance loading.

PARTIAL.reason: The current bounded Guide model exposes exact asset context or explicit unavailability, not a partial projection.

PERMISSION_RESTRICTED.reason: No story demonstrates denied access to contextual guidance.

ERROR.reason: No story demonstrates a recoverable guidance request failure.

surfaces.label: Workspace Insights
surfaces.userJob: Understand evidence-backed workspace preferences without mistaking missing evidence for an inferred preference.

STALE_OR_NEEDS_REFRESH.reason: No story demonstrates preference evidence that needs refresh.

ERROR.reason: No story distinguishes a recoverable request error from unavailable owner data.

surfaces.label: Opportunity Candidate Review
surfaces.userJob: Review an opportunity candidate and its governed disposition without treating an AI suggestion as a decision.

surfaces.label: Governed Action Composer
surfaces.userJob: Compare candidates and prepare an action while authority remains explicitly bounded.

PARTIAL.reason: The current projection resolves to candidate comparison, known empty, or explicit authority unavailability.

STALE_OR_NEEDS_REFRESH.reason: No story demonstrates a candidate comparison that needs refresh.

PERMISSION_RESTRICTED.reason: No story demonstrates a permission-restricted composer.

ERROR.reason: No story distinguishes recoverable failure from explicit authority unavailability.

surfaces.label: Site Manager
surfaces.userJob: Inspect the owner-backed site state and prepare bounded updates without implying publication occurred.

STALE_OR_NEEDS_REFRESH.reason: No story demonstrates a site projection that needs refresh.

ERROR.reason: No story demonstrates a recoverable owner request failure.

surfaces.label: Today Workspace
surfaces.userJob: See the next useful work, create a governed artifact, and move it only through explicit review or handoff.

LOADING.reason: No story demonstrates initial Today workspace loading.

STALE_OR_NEEDS_REFRESH.reason: No story demonstrates a Today item that needs refresh before work continues.
